steps.name: another danger
steps.objective: Go to [Yuran] at the “Luman Coalition Headquarters”.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: … … do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Yes?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Let me say it again. You must meet superhumans and receive the power they possess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They say the power of Iris must be perfected... Why do you need superhuman strength?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Iris Although you have become a god, your current power is much less than that of those who are called superhumans.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You need to rise to the level of power equal to or higher than that of a superhuman, but it seems impossible with Iris's current abilities.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should I do?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Iris, like Iris, cut down fear and fear in the forest of training... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Adventurer must meet the superhumans in person and take some of their power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do I get the strength? It's too vague.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You don't need to worry too much about that. There must be a way to receive it from them in some form.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha… .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: There is no time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: For such an important matter, shouldn't Iris go there in person?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: That is possible, but what would it be like if Iris, who is still in an anxious state, is exposed to the outside world?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: There are more than one person seeking the power he possesses. No one knows what kind of worst situation one may face if one moves hastily.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: And there's another problem. ‘That world’ is coming again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, wait… . In that world... ?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Jewel School wizards have reported that 'that world' has changed course and is coming back here.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Demigod Velosh's divine power was sealed in the battle with Vice, and the world that flew away came back... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It doesn't make sense in the first place. The world created by the power of God can be great if it is great!! There's no way it could be solved with the abilities of a single Demigod, right?!

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Sorry. I got angry for a moment... . I committed a discourtesy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, it's okay. So how much time is left?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'm not sure about that... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Iris becomes stronger than a superhuman and becomes a true god... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Everything will be resolved. Demons seeking the power of God, Agashuras who have no choice but to do bad things, and even the Deimos Church... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Please. Adventurer, hurry and find out how to gain wisdom from the great spirits. Their wisdom will be more helpful than mine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess so. Phew… . Then I'll be back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Does Harmonia know?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There is still a way to go to the world of images, so let’s hurry.)
(Yu-ran senses someone from behind and turns around. A middle-aged man who looks just and benevolent is looking at Yu-ran.)
(Everyone inside the union headquarters greets the middle-aged man politely, calling him Jiscard or Maengjunim.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It looks like it's very difficult.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: No, Master.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Thank you for taking care of things while I was away.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: No. It was just something I had to do.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: That's the person who just passed by.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: That's right. Iris's errand boy I mentioned before... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: What do you think of that person?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: This may be a long story, but is it okay with you?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I'm fine. Then, let’s take a seat and listen.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Adventurer, welcome. See you again soon.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I think I know what brought you here. Shall I guess?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, how would you know if I didn't tell you?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Even though I am in the Goddess's world of images, I naturally learn about stories related to the Goddess when they come from close to the Goddess.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Since the Goddess is in Luman, I can know it to some extent, even if not in detail.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then you won't be able to see the Harmonia evil. If you knew everything like that... .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Uh, did I do something wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hehe, just kidding.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: The goddess's current power is lacking.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: To empower an unstable ability, you need the help of those who use the ability with a stable force.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's superhuman... .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Although they are human, they have abilities close to gods. If they acknowledge it, they can bring back some traces of that power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If the trace is an object, I can take it and give it to Iris, but what if it's not?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: All you have to do is receive strength from them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Are you taking it as is? Is it possible for power to be transmitted suddenly?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: It's similar. Just as the goddess showed Adventurer the path to her dreams... . Because part of your mind is already connected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're probably not looking at too much, are you? It seems like an invasion of privacy... .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: … Don't take it too seriously. It would be easier to just perceive it as a mental connection.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief. Then I have to go meet the superhuman... . Where and who should I meet first?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Meet Mir. He knows more about the outside world than I do.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: If nothing else, if you have some free time after this incident, I hope you will come listen to my story.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: It's not urgent, so if you remember anything, please come and talk to me later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will, Harmonia. Then I'll go. I'm doing great.

steps.name: Let's go to Tartarus
steps.objective: Visit [Shainic] in the “Underground City of Tartarus.”

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Huh. Adventurer!

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Is there anything left to do? Did you come to give me some beef jerky as a gift?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Actually, that beef jerky… . No, I'll buy you a bunch of beef jerky later. Can you tell me where the closest superhuman is to Luman?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Huh, really? really? It's not a lie, it's true?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's real. Now, promise. In the name of Jerky, no, in the name of the Goddess! I, %s, promise Mir some beef jerky.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Wow, that's touching. You promise beef jerky like this... . I'll tell you properly. But why are you looking for a superman?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Explains to Mir why it is necessary to find superhumans.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I see. I'll be happy to tell you because it's for the Goddess. Jiscard came and left again in the meantime.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Then, I guess I should go to an adept who is closer than Adkina in the Land of Illusion?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know where the Land of Illusion is, but what's closer than there?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: If you go all the way to the west of Jude Kingdom, you will find the Amalun Desert, and there is a city underground nearby. It is called ‘Tartaros’, and its owner is a superman.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You have to go all the way through the desert... . What kind of person are you?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I'll talk about Shinik, the King of Shinik.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is the King of Death the King of Death?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: That's right. It is said that a long time ago, when the continent was in chaos, an enormous number of people were led to death on the battlefield.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I don't know if it's because of a punishment or a curse, but it is said that I have a body that doesn't die even if I die.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Probably not undead... .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: They're not undead, they're people. She only looks like a girl, but she is a more complicated person than you think.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: And don't make me feel uncomfortable. If you do something wrong, you might die on the spot... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be careful. thank you. You know Yuran from the Luman Union Headquarters, right? I'll tell Yuran about the beef jerky and ask him to go and ask for it whenever he needs it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll calculate everything later.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Really? Wow, you're really great Adventurer!! I really like it! I will cheer you on, so have a nice trip! I'm off to get some beef jerky!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, it's already gone... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you like it that much, there’s no need to tell you that jerky is a pet food, right? Then, let’s go to Tartarus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello. I… .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I don't think it's been long since I went back.

steps.name: boring job
steps.objective: Go to [Melvik] in the “Underground City of Tartarus.”

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I’m bored… . If I die like this, I wonder if Melbig will write on my tombstone, “Shinick, who died of boredom, sleeps here.”

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ah, I'm bored.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello. I… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Found someone who looks interesting!♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey there. What does it mean to look fun?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Literally. It looks fun. Kyaha!♡

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: But what happened? There won't be many people who will talk to me directly. I'm sure it's because I want something. Right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have a favor to ask... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Please... . I don't know what it is, but if it's interesting, I'll listen to it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not fun... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Speak briefly about what you want to ask Shinik.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hmm… . So I guess I'm not getting anything? I don't want to do anything right now, so go back.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What happens if you get fussy or something like that here? Since you heard my story, you must have been prepared that much, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Instead of running errands for the goddess, how about taking some rest in Tartarus?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: This is a place I created however I want, so everyone can use it however they want as long as it doesn't offend me.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If you go to Butler Melvik, he will provide you with lodging. So, go see the city and have fun.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can't help it. I have no choice but to wait a moment...)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What are you doing? Aren't you going? If you don’t go, I’ll cut your head right away… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, okay. I'll go. You can just go.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehe… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: But what is that guy... ? Your expression is strange. People who have slightly lost their memory of facial expressions used to make those facial expressions... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, I don't know. bothered. It's not even fun, so why are you so worried?

steps.name: construction site disruptors
steps.objective: Defeat [Illusion of Playful Shinik] and [Gravekeeper Shaz] in the "Underground City Construction Site" and report to [Melvik].

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Hello, Adventurer. Welcome to Tartarus.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Shinik greeted me in a hurry and asked what was going on.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Even so, I was curious when Adventurer would come to Tartarus, and this is how I got to see him. It's an honor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know about me?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I heard that you are fighting for just causes with unique bravery.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Because he looks like a bastard, and because he does the work of a goddess, there is a rumor in Tartarus that he is the 'goddess' bastard.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A motherfucker, not just a motherfucker, but a motherfucker of a goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… . It's not wrong, though. Thank you for your concern.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Hehe, what?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Looking at your expression, it looks like you have something to say.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: If you pretend, pretend! You recognize me as expected. I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I don't know what Shinik is thinking, but he hasn't been doing anything these days. When he gets into something, he does it without stopping... .

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I'm doing some of the city's work... . It was too much for me to do the work that Shinik did, such as security and management, so I contracted with external personnel.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: But here, a slight problem arose. Wait, before I continue, can I ask you a favor?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: If you don't mind being rude, I would like you to chase away those who are disturbing the construction site.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I'm sorry I can't explain everything in detail because I'm in such a hurry. I'll tell you again when I get back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: You seem to be hesitant for some reason. While I'm back, I'll give a good word to Shinik. So that you can take what you want.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, yes!! I will come back quickly!!

steps.name: The construction site is in chaos
steps.objective: Defeat the [Freeling Mask Bandit] and [Gargoyle Statue] in the “Underground City Construction Site” and report to [Melvik].

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: You are amazing! Thanks to you, it eased my worries to some extent.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I already told Shinik about it, but he still seemed uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Should I wait a little longer... .

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Then I will continue to explain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Then I'll ask you a favor.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: The guild that signed a contract with us is [Blue Spear Guild], which is famous for its security. The reason it's a problem is because it's not done properly.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: The monsters that came out of the “Room of Hell”, the bandits who came after hearing the rumor that the city was abandoned, and… .

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: The construction site became a complete mess as the guild members of the Blue Spear Guild, who seemed to have different plans, got mixed up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess I'll have to sort out the chaos first. Then can I come?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Yes? I haven't even asked for it yet... ..

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back soon. Since you helped me, I will handle it quickly and come back.

steps.name: Why the city is in chaos
steps.objective: Go to [Ruin] at the “Underground City Construction Site”.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Thank you, Adventurer. Thank you for resolving Tartarus' concerns... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? By the way, what do you think about Shinik?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: There is no answer yet. What should I do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Melvik worked hard, but there is nothing we can do about it. I'll just stay for a few days and then go somewhere else.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Would you mind? Adventurer, there may be a story at the Superman Memorial that might be of interest to you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Superhuman Memorial Hall?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: The Superhuman Memorial Hall was created by Shinik because he wanted to create something like a landmark for our city.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: A book containing stories about past superhumans, starting with the treasured possessions of the seven living superhumans. etc.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: It's a small museum with not much, but some exhibits.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How were they able to bring such precious items? Can't there be hostile superhumans?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Basically, you stole it.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: He used his curse by arguing with the person who refused to give it to him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could it be that they repeated until they got tired of the ability to not die even if they died?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Yes. you're right. Ahahaha. Shinik is the kind of person who can do that.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Now, the Superhuman Memorial Hall has become a space that I cannot enter. Master Landain of the Blue Spear Guild has gone in and is not coming out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… . The guild master is planning something... .

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Looking at your expression, it looks like you are going to visit the Superhuman Memorial Hall. I'd like to ask you to do this one more time.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: On one side of the construction site is Ruin, a senior guild member of the Blue Spear Guild. Ask him about the Superhuman Memorial Hall and the Guild Master.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: He'll tell you something helpful.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Ah, %s. I have a special request to make, is it okay?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: If you have any thoughts, please talk to me later.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Since it is an urgent matter, I think you should first find out what is going on at the Superhuman Memorial Hall.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I should. Then I'll come back quickly.

steps.name: A person with distorted power
steps.objective: Go to the “Superhuman Memorial Hall”, kill [Landain], and report to [Ruin].

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Someone said it was you. I was dealing with some troublesome guys over there, so I looked into it and found out that he was the hero who saved Jude Kingdom?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hero… It's not true, but I guess it's because they say it is.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: You don't deny it. Since you're here, I think you want something from me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can you tell me what's going on at the Superhuman Memorial Hall?

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: I didn't want to tell you that... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Melvik said he would talk about it.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: If it was sent by Melvik, I can't help it. Because it's not at a level I can solve.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Guild Master Landain is crazy. I never thought my desire to grow my guild would end up like this... .

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: I feel like I have some kind of power... . It wasn't normal power. It seems like something that humans should never touch.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: After using that power, he suffered and looked strange. Many guild members came forward to stop him... . It was impossible.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: It happened inside the Tartarus Superhuman Memorial, but Shinik didn't pay any attention. It's as if he wants someone to solve it.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Guild members who were afraid of Landain's power remained loyal to him, and those who did not died at the hands of Landain, who was crazy about power.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: And then I went into the Superhuman Memorial Hall. To use that place as a hideout to take over Tartarus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It reminds me a bit of some kind of powerful force... .

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Landain was clearly distressed and worried about the process. But now it has become a monster that doesn't even worry about it.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Please. It can't be a coincidence that a hero like you came here. I think you can protect Tartarus, including Landain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a bit embarrassing to keep calling me a hero. Should we still go there sometime? I also want to visit the Superhuman Memorial Museum... .

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: You seem to think it's easy. Still, you'd better be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for your concern. I'll be back soon.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Oh, I have something to ask. hey!! hey!! It's already gone.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: (In the darkness, you can feel the presence of someone looking at where Ruin was.)

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: There. You are secretly eavesdropping. What is he doing?

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: (Ruin approaches the place where there are people, but there is no one there.)

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Oh, did I see it wrong? I'm sure it was here... . Isn't it? There was a lot to worry about because of Landain, so that might be the case. Phew… .

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: But what is this… ? I think something fell... .

steps.name: I need permission
steps.objective: Visit [Shainic] in the “Underground City of Tartarus.”

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: You're back. If you came back, Landain would have been resolved... . Stupid Landain... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: By the way, do you know anything about this stuff?

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: (Ruin takes out small stones from his pocket and shows them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, this is!! Where did you get this?

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Earlier, I felt something coming from over there, so I went over there, and it was in my pocket.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: But what is this that is so surprising?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a magic stone.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Magic stone? Is this a stone that contains magical power?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. It's that kind of magic stone, but it seems to be a different type from the one Ban and Mara made. It's a magic stone without magical power... .

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: I don't know who Ban and Mara are, but somehow they seem like bad guys too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. They are really bad guys.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's no way this could have landed here by accident. if… .

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: I will take care of the cleanup here. I'm not sure... .

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Speaking of that magic stone... , was located near the abyss room.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hell's room? Then I guess I should go there.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: To go to the abyss room, you need Shinik's permission. Because it's not a place that anyone can go to... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's a place that requires permission, it seems like an incredibly dangerous place.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: It's exactly as you guessed. Shinik, who can't stand being bored, put a monster inside to make it a fun place.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Then, demons flowed into the abyss room from somewhere, and Shinik, who found it amusing, set up a magic barrier to prevent even the demons from coming out.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Then he put a lot of gold coins and treasures inside and spread the word. They say that the treasures that come out after catching the demons in the room of hell belong to the person who caught them... .

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: So many people flocked there. To deal with strange, unpleasant, ugly darkness and demons... .

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Many people died, but Shinik didn't really care. It's even more strange that everyone just thought he was that kind of person and overlooked it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just hearing it sounds serious. Well, something like that… .

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: By the way. It is said that Malphas, the strongest among them, resurrected the ghost of a human wizard, but Shinik's condition became strange.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: I sent away all the Adventurer who went to the hell room and did not allow anyone to enter.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Many Adventurer people who wanted to take the gold coins and treasures did not answer when they asked why.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: I don't know what you're thinking. That's why Landain also tried to take over this place with strange powers... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've been to many places, but I don't think there's any city with such complicated circumstances.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The owner of this city, Shinik, has a very eccentric personality... .

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: I think it would be a good idea to go to Shinik first, tell him the truth, and get permission before going in.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Now I have to think about what to do with the remaining guild members. Because that seems like what I would do. Anyway, thanks for your help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? I'll go now.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Uh, okay. You're already gone. Should I say it is urgent or should I say the momentum is fast?

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: By the way, that guy… . It seems like you know how to use great power. amazing… , Unlike that Landain guy... .

steps.name: The end of Tartarus, the abyss
steps.objective: Defeat [Ixion] and [Malphas] in the "Room of Hell" and report to [Shainic] in the "Underground City of Tartarus".

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looks like he was waiting for me.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Are you thinking of going to the Hell Room? I don’t mind going, but… . Do I really need to go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can you tell me if you're hiding something?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's nothing you can't do here, but if you don't do anything, there's a reason. There may be a big risk, so is it okay to stay like this?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'm here, so what kind of danger arises?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Would you like to look at this for a second? Landain had it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Show Shinik a magic stone without magic power.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, it's a unique magic stone? Where should I look? It belongs to the Deimos Church. uh? However, the magic stone created through Agashura's technique... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could it be that Ban and Mara joined hands with the Deimos Church? ?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's about that fake Agashura clan. Those fakes can't even tell the difference between real and fake anyway. don't mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is real and what is fake Agash?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's troublesome to answer... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… . You know that the Agashura clan are people who have no choice but to commit evil, right? What if they're targeting Tartarus?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to enter the Hell Chamber because their ultimate target might be a goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It doesn't end just because Shinik doesn't do anything. Because someone has to do it.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If you really want to go, I won't stop you. Will he be able to come back alive?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Everyone said that, but I always came back alive.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You are confident. You're so funny... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You are finally out of your boredom. Well, I just believe in myself and the people who believe in me.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yeah? Then go and take care of Malphas, the demon who is trying to use the room in the abyss as his hideout.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I captured and imprisoned someone who entered the abyss room through a dimensional gap, and continued to increase his strength by absorbing the souls of Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: He said he would get revenge on me, and I wonder how strong he has become.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that all? I don’t think so… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then talk to me later. I will leave knowing that I have permission.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (Shaynic is staring at the back of %s heading towards the abyss room.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ah, Melvik… .

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: He has departed. Hey, Shinik… ?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Do I need to stop you? The room in Hell is now... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: … Wouldn't it work out somehow?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Phew. No matter what else I do, I can't touch him again. Would it be possible if he were a god? This is why everyone wants to become God.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: No matter how powerful you are, you are only a shell of a human being. See, I am like that. Look at me so helpless.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Shinik… .

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: A human, even just one person, came this far... . Even though I was trapped in the abyss, no one came this far.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh. It was a bit difficult.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: You seem to be a bit different from other humans. The composition of the power itself is different from that of ordinary humans.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: I really didn't know that Yeongtaeng was so weak that he couldn't stop even a single person. There's no point in waking me up.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: I thought that inspiration would be able to fix Shinik.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Young Taengi? The wizard who appeared as a ghost? Why Shinik?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: I guess you want to know. Then you'll have to take me down.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that means I can ask you properly if I take you down?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: If only I could win. I promise. Because I'm different from other demons like Lux, I keep my promises.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Before I make that promise, let me make a suggestion. Won't you use the power you have for me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why me?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: It looks like I'm destined to only run someone else's errands... . In that case, how about coming under me?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: The great Malphas gives gifts to human souls who enter the Maw chambers.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: The more you swallow those souls, the more power you have to look down on Lux. Because I already made this hell room like that. how is it?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: I am giving you the honor of becoming a great human being. Think about it carefully.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hehehe. You stupid crow. Do you think I'll just take whatever the devil says?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: What a foolish human being. You'll regret it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I refuse. Both humans and demons do stupid things because they are obsessed with power. Of course, it would be nice to have power, but that's not it!

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Power is good. Why do you think it's not good? So what power do you have now?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Be honest. If you have power, you want to be higher and dominate those below you.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Now, let me ask you one more time. Don't you want to come under me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I say it again, I refuse! I will take you down and find out what I want to know!!

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: My suggestion was blatantly ignored. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Okay, if you beat me, I'll answer your question. But, you won't hear anything from me.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Here I swallow your soul. That is your destiny, the truth of the world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … So where should I give it a try?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Come on, come on! You foolish human being who cannot even accept the reason for the existence of power!!

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: I can't believe it... . I never thought I would fall down like this. This is the price you pay for belittling humans... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey devil. Come to your senses. I have a question to ask, will you answer it? Devil? yes?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: … okay.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: I lost. I'll answer your question properly. Because a promise is a promise.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's surprising that you admit defeat... . Among beings that call themselves ‘evil’, cases like this are rare, so it’s a bit surprising. Take a look at this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know anything about this magic stone? It was found at the entrance to the Hell Room.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Shows the magic stone to Malphas.)

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: It is a magic stone of the Deimos Church that possesses the magic of Agashura... . Interesting stuff. This was dropped in front of the abyss room?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: I can't even step out of the abyss room because of Shinik's binding curse, so it's funny that this was discovered in front of me.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Ah, I'm sure they're planning something. They're not even devils, but they do bad things. Other than that, I don't know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. By the way, who is the wizard who appeared as a ghost?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Do you not know Ixion, the heroic wizard who protected the Kingdom of Jude during the Dark War in Eastland a long time ago?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I am an outsider so there is no way I would know. I think I heard that somewhere. Ah, I heard it on Luman.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Ixion is a man who did anything to protect the kingdom from the Deimos Church. Even as a devil, I thought he was crazy. Sigh… .

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: He thought it was something that would enhance his reputation, and in the end he chose something that would only be done in the Deimos Church.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Young children were forcibly injected with magical powers and forced to go to battle under the 'shackles' of darkness. The weapon itself... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Bondage?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Should I say it's a curse that can't be escaped... . The Deimos Church also paid attention to that restraint.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: So many people died, and the souls of the dead people came to the devils. I too could take many souls. I am grateful to Ixion for that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're worshiping a wizard like that as a hero? Does Jude Kingdom know that fact?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: I don't know that much. Humans are stupid, and they will cover it up even if they don't do anything. As the devil, I guarantee it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shut up. So what happened to those kids?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: I guess I'm curious. Then let me tell you. The magic that Ixion forcibly injected into the children caused them to run wild and lead to their deaths.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: After the war, the children who did not die themselves died at the hands of Ixion. Because it was no longer useful. That is the fate of those children... .

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Then only one child survived. The person who cherished the red ribbon more than anyone else... .

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: There was nothing special about the child surviving. I'm not sure if I'm lucky or bad, but I just didn't die due to a curse. That child is… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shh. Until there. I don't think I need to listen anymore.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Is that so? Shall we conclude the conversation then?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: It was nice to see you. The human who defeated me... . Okay then.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: (Malphas sneers and chooses to disappear himself.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey! wait for a sec!!!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Malphas disappeared on the spot without a trace. I can't feel any evil energy, as if it had disappeared properly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it over now? ? Oh, that's not what I'm saying. Usually, when I say something like this, it shows up again... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew. Then let's go now. Because there are many things I want to ask Shinik.

steps.name: It's over for now
steps.objective: Talk to [Melvik] in the “Underground City of Tartarus.”

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You came. Even if Malphas was a stupid demon, it wouldn't have been easy... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was difficult.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So, did you find out what you wanted to know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. The devil only knew that the magic stone belonged to the Deimos Church and was created using Agashura's magic. Other than that, I have no income.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There really isn't any.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, there really isn't.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ahahahahaha. You are a really interesting person. He's also a fun-looking person♡ Isn't he the motherfucker of a goddess?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not like you're a fool. (with a straight face)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Are you a bastard or an errand boy? Can’t I just give you what you want in return?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The story is fast.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Then would you like to come closer? Let's see. Your hair is pretty. Is it okay if I put my hand on my head?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I say it's not okay, something scary will happen.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Bingo! Right, how did you know? Hehe♡

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (Shaynick places his hand on %s's head. Black and red lights linger from Shinick's fingertips and begin to come together and linger as one.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (Soon, the light surrounds %s's head and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Is it already over?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Boring, right? The process of giving strength may seem more complicated than you think, but it's surprisingly simple. It was like that back then... . Oh, pretend you didn’t hear this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (At that time, maybe….)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: This will be helpful to that beginner goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't think it's a big surprise.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I don't know either. No one knows what will happen to that power later. Isn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I will go.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Are you just going to use me like this and then just go away? what's the matter? Regretfully♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey there. Shinik… . I mean the comment now. Do you know that it's full of misunderstandings?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's because I want to do something fun using you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anything fun? Isn't it dangerous?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's a secret now. Then wait a moment. Okay? Because there is someone I want to meet.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: And before that, be careful not to be killed by the snake biting your own tail♡ That snake. I love swallowing people like you.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Then go to Melvik. Don't ever come to me until I call you. Because I don’t know what I will do if I change my mind. Hehehe. Then take a rest for a few days.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, see you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hehe, let's go first. But what is a snake that bites its tail?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Shynick stares at %s's back until it disappears.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (A black shadow that appears to be a man appears in a dark alley behind Shinik.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (Shaynick walks into the alley with a slight sneer.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's a terrible animal smell.
Thank you for your cooperation.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I really am grateful. Well, it's all just based on your plan.
As promised, once this is all over, I will grant your wish. There's not much time left, so just wait. Please.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Looks like you have a lot to handle. I wonder if you can do it. I wonder if you, dying, can do what even God could not do... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Now that I think about it, I'm jealous. Dying... .
I'm jealous of everything.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Okay, now I hope you don't show up in my city for a while. Appearing again would be proof that things weren't finished properly.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Head of the Agashura clan, Kazno Nasu.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (Shinyk raises Death Scythe and aims it into the darkness.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (Gradually, the darkness disappears, and the figure of a young man with dreadlock-like hairstyle appears.)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: As expected, you are selfish, Myeongwang.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If that time comes, I will kill you with my own hands. Well, I won't be bored.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: (Kazno gently pushes Shinick's Death Side with his finger.)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: I will never die for you. I have a lot left to do, both for this world and for my old friends.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: That's a bit annoying, maybe... .

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: It looks like our conversation with Shinik has come to an end.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He told me to rest for a few days.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Okay. By the way, Adventurer is great.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: It's not easy to change Shinik's mind... .

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: And thank you for keeping it a secret.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, did you know… ?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: No. I just thought there must be something there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is this person again...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was enough to destroy Malphas. Uh, but who is the person Shinik is saying hello to?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I'm not sure about that. Shinik will take care of it. Because I'm just an ordinary butler. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No matter how you look at it, it doesn't seem like he's an ordinary person.)

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Then, I hope you can rest well at the accommodation I prepared until Shinik calls you again. If there is anything you need or feel uncomfortable about, please let us know right away.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Since you are recognized by Shinik, we will treat you as the best guest.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Ah, %s. I have another favor to ask you. Is it okay with you? It's such a trivial thing that you can do or don't have to do.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I will tell you in detail later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. thank you. I guess I should get some rest now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Whoa... I have no idea what will happen again. Anyway, is Iris doing well?)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm doing well. So don't worry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly, a faint image of Iris appears in %s's field of vision.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris? Surely, Iris? Iris is in Luman, right?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes, it's me. I was still training in the forest of water lilies.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how did you appear in front of me?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: How should I explain it… . It's definitely me, but it's like a hologram that only %s can see.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: This is your first time trying it. How is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What a convenient feature!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Are you talking about me as if I were a magic communicator?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahahaha. I'm so surprised... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's okay. I also suddenly appeared. I just thought I wanted to have a conversation, but I was a little surprised that it ended up like this.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I think it's probably because I accepted Shinik's power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As expected, the power of a superhuman is effective. thank god.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: However, since it has not stabilized yet, it will be difficult to maintain it for a long time... … … … .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: (Iris's image freezes and does not move. It then blurs and disappears from sight.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a bit clumsy, but it's amazing. I just received the power of a superhuman, but something like this is possible.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know if you're listening... . Iris, cheer up. Because I will do my best too.
